001-empty-log.json.note: An empty log means the default build order and no decorations toggled.

002-order-only-noticeboard.json.note: A build order that lists only noticeboard, the rest keeping their default order.

003-order-only-workshop-1.json.note: A build order that lists only workshop_1, the rest keeping their default order.

004-order-only-well.json.note: A build order that lists only well, the rest keeping their default order.

005-order-only-cottage-1.json.note: A build order that lists only cottage_1, the rest keeping their default order.

006-order-only-garden-plots.json.note: A build order that lists only garden_plots, the rest keeping their default order.

007-order-only-crossing.json.note: A build order that lists only crossing, the rest keeping their default order.

008-order-only-watermill.json.note: A build order that lists only watermill, the rest keeping their default order.

009-order-only-workshop-2.json.note: A build order that lists only workshop_2, the rest keeping their default order.

010-order-only-cottage-2.json.note: A build order that lists only cottage_2, the rest keeping their default order.

011-order-only-bell-tower.json.note: A build order that lists only bell_tower, the rest keeping their default order.

012-order-only-bakery.json.note: A build order that lists only bakery, the rest keeping their default order.

013-order-only-market-hall.json.note: A build order that lists only market_hall, the rest keeping their default order.

014-build-order-all-twelve.json.note: A build order that lists all 12 progression structures.

015-build-order-reversed.json.note: All 12 progression structures in the reverse of the default order.

016-build-order-eleven.json.note: A build order of 11 structures, with one left to its default place.

017-build-order-two.json.note: A build order of two structures.

018-order-partial-keeps-default.json.note: Three listed structures, with the rest keeping their default order after them.

019-full-order-with-decoration.json.note: A complete build order followed by a decoration placed the same day.

020-decoration-on.json.note: A decoration placed on the ground.

022-decoration-bench-on.json.note: A bench decoration placed four days before the reference day.

023-decoration-tree-off.json.note: A tree decoration put away six days before the reference day.

024-decoration-id-min-length.json.note: A two-character decoration id, the shortest legal.

025-decoration-id-max-length.json.note: A 32-character decoration id, the longest legal.

026-decoration-id-digits-underscores.jso.note: A decoration id with a digit and an underscore.

027-decoration-id-trailing-underscore.js.note: A decoration id ending in an underscore is still a valid slug.

028-decoration-toggle-on-then-off.json.note: The same decoration placed and then put away.

029-decoration-put-away-then-placed.json.note: A decoration placed, put away, then placed again.

030-mixed-log.json.note: A build order, a decoration placed, a decoration put away and a second build order.

031-order-and-decoration-same-day.json.note: A build order and a decoration made on the same day.

032-two-build-orders.json.note: Two build orders in sequence, where the later one is the one in force.

033-same-time-two-entries.json.note: Two entries with the same t and day, kept in log order.

034-entry-time-at-min.json.note: A build order whose t is the legal minimum timestamp.

035-entry-time-at-max.json.note: A decoration whose t is the legal maximum timestamp.

037-long-log-of-fifty.json.note: Fifty entries alternating decorations and build orders.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

006-missing-log.json.note: log is required, even when empty.

011-privacy-extra-field.json.note: privacy is closed, so a project field is rejected.

012-log-not-array.json.note: log must be an array of entries.

013-entry-not-object.json.note: Each log entry must be an object.

014-entry-wrong-kind.json.note: kind must be build_order or decoration.

015-entry-kind-missing.json.note: kind is required on every entry.

016-entry-missing-t.json.note: t is required on every entry.

017-entry-missing-day.json.note: day is required on every entry.

018-entry-t-in-seconds.json.note: t in seconds is below the millisecond range.

019-entry-t-fractional.json.note: t must be a whole number of milliseconds.

020-entry-t-string.json.note: t must be an integer, not an ISO string.

021-entry-day-unpadded.json.note: day must be YYYY-MM-DD, so 2026-1-5 is rejected.

022-entry-day-today.json.note: day must be a calendar date, not the word today.

023-entry-day-month-13.json.note: day with month 13 breaks the day pattern.

024-entry-extra-field.json.note: Entries are closed, so an extra note field is rejected.

025-build-order-with-decoration-fields.j.note: A build_order entry may not carry decoration fields.

026-decoration-with-order.json.note: A decoration entry may not carry an order.

027-order-with-duplicates.json.note: The order must not repeat a structure.

028-order-with-campfire.json.note: campfire is not a progression structure, so it cannot be ordered.

029-order-with-founders-stone.json.note: founders_stone comes from the backfill and cannot be ordered.

030-order-of-thirteen.json.note: An order of 13 exceeds the 12 maximum; the repeated entry also breaks uniqueness at the same path, because only 12 distinct structures exist.

031-order-empty.json.note: An order needs at least one structure.

032-order-item-number.json.note: Order items are structure ids, not numbers.

035-decoration-too-short.json.note: A decoration id needs at least two characters.

036-decoration-leading-digit.json.note: A decoration id must start with a letter.

037-decoration-too-long.json.note: A decoration id may be at most 32 characters.

038-decoration-hyphen.json.note: Decoration ids use underscores, not hyphens.

041-decoration-missing-id.json.note: A decoration entry needs its decoration id.

042-second-entry-t-in-seconds.json.note: An error in the second entry is reported at its own index.
